messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: search-api v6.2.0-canary -> 3% traffic in us-central-1. change-window 2026-03-23 08:00-09:00 UTC. notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/search-api/6.2.0

nina: watching metrics. small uptick in connection errors and p99 latency. p99 ~450ms (baseline ~160ms).

otto: I see a concentration of 502s from edge-proxy handoff. Also a subtle rise in connection resets in tcp stats.

rachel: can we gate and pin the canary cohort back to v6.1.9? prefer to avoid a broad rollback but want to shrink blast radius.

devops-bot: Policy check: error-rate exceeded soft threshold. Recommend manual pause for triage.

pager: authorizing pause. nina, please execute the pin when ready.

nina: running pin: /release pause service=search-api cohort=canary version=v6.1.9 reason="502 spike"

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 3%. Cohort pinned to v6.1.9. action_id=rl-4891234567-pause

devops-bot: Routing swap confirmed. Telemetry will update in ~60s.

otto: after pin, errors dropping toward baseline. Good signal. I'll pull proxy logs and compare keepalive/timeouts.

rachel: next steps: 1) otto to triage proxy resets; 2) if config drift, revert infra; 3) if bug, cut hotfix and run 0.5% probe behind feature flag.

nina: will update release notes and add change-window annotation. scheduling a 15m follow-up at 08:20 UTC.

pager: monitoring the window. escalate to incident if thresholds breach again.

rachel: thanks team — leaving thread open for triage updates. :white_check_mark:
